svg.title: Retrieval-augmented generation, end to end
svg.desc: Two pipelines share one vector index. Documents are chunked and embedded ahead of time; each question is embedded, matched, re-ranked and grounded before the model writes a word.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Noto Sans SC, monospace
text.tspan: A — C INGESTION · OFFLINE, ON EVERY DOCUMENT CHANGE
